text:
Merger Consideration components: 1) Merger Consideration: cash of $150.00 per share of Company Common Stock outstanding (excluding Cancelled Shares and Dissenting Shares). 2) Stock consideration: Merger Sub Shares convert to Surviving Company Stock on a 1-for-1 basis. 3) Equity Award Consideration: for vested Company Equity Awards, cash equal to Merger Consideration plus accrued but unpaid dividend equivalents. 4) Dissenting Shares: payment for Dissenting Shares determined under DGCL Section 262. 5) Adjustment to Merger Consideration: if outstanding shares change, the Merger Consideration shall be appropriately adjusted to provide the same economic effect.
Each share of Company Common Stock issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time shall be automatically converted into the right to receive $150.00 in cash, without interest (the Merger Consideration), subject to the withholding tax provisions of Section 3.5.
